property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee address, C.transfer always completes (does not revert) and returns true when the callee's called function succeeds for every element; the mutant that iterates i<=_tos.length will sometimes access out-of-bounds and thus revert (causing transfer to fail) for some inputs (non-empty _tos), breaking this universal completion-and-return-true property.
change_summary: Change the loop bound to i<=_tos.length so when _tos non-empty the loop runs one extra iteration and attempts an out-of-bounds access, causing revert or different return behavior.
